how_to_read: Plan T3.3: adjudicated positive/negative fixtures per case. auto_attach in news/config/cases.json is honoured by the build ONLY while every fixture here classifies correctly under the case rule_version; a fixture whose article is absent from the (gitignored) corpus is unverifiable and withholds auto-attach.

Each fixture names its corpus article by path, url and content sha256; expected is whether the article BELONGS to the affair (a passing mention, the place, or a namesake does not). Labelled by the plan author from the corpus text on 2026-09-22: a reviewed set, not a held-out adjudication by a second reader.

At least two positives and two negatives per case; the negatives must include the plan named hard cases (the Petrohan pass as a road, Okolchitsa as Botev peak, the Kyustendil mayor and the football coach named Ognyan Atanasov, and a passing campaign mention for each).

Rule v2 (2026-09-22) added three NEGATIVES that rule v1 had published as members of the Petrohan case — the fixture set must contain the failure shapes it exists to catch, not only the shapes the plan predicted.
